|game_text='''0 side - Local Uprising (V)'''

Deploy Hoth system and Main Power Generators. May deploy Echo Base Garrison and/or Maneuvering Flaps. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Hoth Sentry or non-Hoth locations (except Rendezvous Point). T-47 Battle Formation is an Out Of Play Interrupt and Immune to Sense. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth. Flip this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. Place out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'

'''7 side - Liberation (V)'''

While this side up, whenever you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of Hoth locations you occupy. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site (except 1st Marker) you control with both a T-47 and a Rebel. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle any one card. Flip this card if you do not control two exterior Hoth sites. Place out of play if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'
|game_text_note=Game text transcribed from VirtualCards4.pdf slip (IA Wayback). Official text as of December 4, 2006. Triangles (A/C/S/X ICON KEY letters) expanded per cover ICON KEY (A=Immune to Alter; C=Immune to Control; S=Immune to Sense; X/pilot-power = Adds X to power of anything he/she pilots; up-triangle = Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; down-triangle = Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle). Cover also defines maintenance-cost and grabber icons. Uniqueness bullet shown as (*). Other sheet icons (side affiliation, planet/site, etc.) named from the printed slip where readable.
